summary: Panel kit 7: remaining dialogs with Game1-4 / Text backgrounds
author: client
body:
Spec step 7. Same pattern, one dialog per cycle; the census in spec step 8 lists the users.

Done when: no dialog draws a Game1-4 or Text frame as its background.

comments.author: client
comments.body:
Batch 1 done (client editor). Checkpoint 1ef330ae (dialog_box.h/.cpp + 6 dialogs); HUD nits under 433a40e5.

- Census: 40 files call draw_new_dialog_box with Game1-4/Text; 3 are the converted dialogs' fallbacks. Families: small gold boxes (6), 258x339 list dialogs with scrollbar (8), 258x339 menus (13), magic/spells, notices (2), crusade title strips (3), change-password overlay, map (Game4 frame 43 is a part, not a background).
- Batch 1, plain gold-corner boxes: item_drop, resurrect, confirm_exchange, fishing (270x104), item_drop_amount (215x87), npc_action_query (215x87 / 252x87). New IDialogBox::draw_kit_background(kit_frame::gold_box, x, y, w, h) = cloth + light wood + gold corners (closest match in hh0066_box_styles.jpg); sprite fallback kept; static style, no per-frame allocation.
- In game: all six drawn (hh0066_b1_sheet.jpg); NPC query opened by clicking a guard, the other five via a temporary file-triggered path (removed; grep clean). Text input of the amount box closed cleanly. settings.json unchanged.
- HUD nits: else instead of the mid-function return; unused time locals dropped.
- Open for the user: the illustrated backgrounds (portrait, horned figure, hexagram, hammer, ruined city; hh0066_backgrounds.jpg) - drop them for plain kit frames, or keep them inside the kit frame.
- Builds: Windows Debug and Linux, 0 warnings.

comments.author: pm
comments.body: User ruling, 2026-11-24, in chat: "Drop the pictures". The illustrated backgrounds (portrait, horned figure, hexagram, hammer, ruined city) are not carried into the kit; the remaining dialogs convert to plain kit frames.

comments.author: pm
comments.body: Batch 1 committed in 3df92c77 after a read-only review passed (one comment nit fixed). Next: magic and skill dialogs.

comments.author: client
comments.body: Batch 2 (magic, skill) done, uncommitted. Plain kit frames (no portrait, no baked hexagram), titles and sunken insets at the original places; skill scrollbar is the kit groove + thumb on the same 274 px travel. Old-sprite fallback kept. Magic dialog also draws the HH-0071 `magic_circle` kit frame at (28, 62) via new `panel_kit::piece` / `kit_dialog::piece`. Checkpoints 6ec97a93 (dialogs), 3ae72f41 (panel_kit). Windows and Linux builds clean. Shots: build/screenshots/hh0066_b2_*.jpg.

comments.author: pm
comments.body: Batch 2 (skill, magic) committed in b3b40459 after review PASS. Next: shops.

comments.author: client
comments.body: Batch 3 (shop family) done, uncommitted, checkpoint 812d451c. Shop, sell list, sell or repair (all four modes), repair all and bank/warehouse share Game2 frame 2; they now draw through two new IDialogBox helpers, `draw_shop_frame(title_frame, x, y)` and `draw_shop_scrollbar(x, y, pos, pointer_loc, track_frame)`: plain kit frame with rivet corners (matched to the original's), standard red title with flourishes, a 220-wide sunken panel, kit groove and thumb on the original 274 px travel. Old sprites remain the fallback. Magic shop (Game4 frame 1, 304x328) uses a different frame and is not in this batch. Windows and Linux builds clean. Shots: build/screenshots/hh0066_b3_*.jpg. Bridge thumb drag (mouse_down/move/up) still does not scroll; the wheel was verified instead.
